numbering: Episodes numbered continuously as in Wikipedia's overall 'Story' column: Seasons 1-3 are 1-37, the First Kiss film's four TV parts are 38-41, and the Stairway to Adulthood special is 42-43.

arcs.name: Season 1: The Battle of Confessions Begins
arcs.summary: At elite Shuchiin Academy, student council president Miyuki Shirogane and vice-president Kaguya Shinomiya like each other, but each is too proud to confess first and schemes to make the other do it.
events: Kaguya and Shirogane wage daily mind games over who will confess first.
Secretary Chika Fujiwara keeps wrecking their plans by accident.
Treasurer Yu Ishigami joins the council's antics.
The pair spend the summer fireworks festival together.

arcs.name: Season 2: Love Is War?
arcs.summary: The second term brings new rivals, a student council election, and more failed schemes.
events: Miko Iino runs against Shirogane in the student council election.
Ishigami's past and the reason he is shunned at school are revealed.
Shirogane wins re-election and Miko joins the council.

arcs.name: Season 3: Ultra Romantic
arcs.summary: As the school culture festival nears, Shirogane makes plans to finally settle things with Kaguya.
events: Shirogane reveals he will be studying at Stanford next year.
Ishigami grows closer to Tsubame Koyasu.
At the culture festival Shirogane and Kaguya share their first kiss.

arcs.name: The First Kiss Never Ends
arcs.summary: After the culture festival, Kaguya and Shirogane have to figure out what their relationship actually is.
events: Kaguya struggles to act normally around Shirogane after the kiss.
The two spend Christmas together and take their relationship a step further.

arcs.name: The Stairway to Adulthood
arcs.summary: A special that looks back on the early days of Kaguya and Shirogane's relationship.
events: Kaguya and Shirogane navigate life as a new couple.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga.
